  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:5326086280",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Handle the no-timeout case using the OS primitives' native indefinite timeout (NULL for select, negative for poll) while keeping the cap for large finite timeouts",
      "quote": "could we handle the \"_no timeout_\" case using the OS primitives' native indefinite timeout, while keeping this cap for explicitly specified large finite timeouts ?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author dropped the second commit to simplify backporting; winterrdog dropped the suggestion and gave Approach ACK",
      "author_replies": ["c:5847188854", "c:5865812893"],
      "other_replies": ["c:5865455142"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5865945894",
      "status_by_quote": "A protracted wait timeout is simple and does the job fine. So, no need to get dogmatic about native infinite wait"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5865455142",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Limit the change to the first commit (or a smaller cap) to ease backporting",
      "quote": "I wonder how much we want to backport here. I doubt there is a use case to have a timeout of more than a few hours, so capping to 1 day, or even 14 days, or the first commit should be fine for a backp",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped the second commit to keep the backport simple",
      "author_replies": ["c:5865812893", "c:5872317032"],
      "other_replies": ["c:5865809869"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5865812893",
      "status_by_quote": "dropped the second commit so this is just the cap in `Sock::WaitMany` and should be easy to backport."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4123034508",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Start Wait() in a thread and send data after a delay to ensure select()/poll() actually wait with the large timeout",
      "quote": "i am wondering if we should instead have `Wait()` start first, and then send a few bytes, so that we actually make `select()`/`poll()` wait with the large timeout.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the unit test to wait in a thread before sending data",
      "author_replies": ["c:5872317032"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5872317032",
      "status_by_quote": "the test now starts `Wait()` in a thread with the 5 year timeout and only sends the data after 100ms"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5353383052",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Use a much shorter timeout than 5 years in bitcoin-cli (such as 1-4 days), possibly in a follow-up",
      "quote": "why don't we use sth much shorter than 5 years? even 1-4 days feels like plenty of room here",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author preferred keeping this PR minimal for backport and doing it as a follow-up; reviewer agreed",
      "author_replies": ["c:5898889351", "c:5899215708"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5898991721",
      "status_by_quote": "Sure. That's fine"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5326086280",

    {
      "id": "r:5359182783",

      "substantive": true,

    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "nothing",

      "id": ""
    }
  ],
  "notes": "winterrdog suggested using a shorter timeout than 5 years in bitcoin-cli, agreed to author's proposal of leaving that for a follow-up PR, and provided a Tested ACK on Windows."
}
